invariant.portable_principle: One routed read-only family may share execution and synthesis invariants while each member retains its own final-artifact and completeness contract.
binding_guards: partial, unsupported, missing, skipped, and error evidence is never clean
generated, dependency, test, output, and symlink exclusions remain member-owned
every actionable final-artifact finding reaches the consolidated result

tooling.selected: one family manifest, shared core, three concise member contracts, a family-local max-three read-only launcher, and fresh non-context execution lanes
tooling.model_evaluation: GPT-5.6 Luna at medium effort, 72 gate calls, five timed A/B/C trials plus one unseen host and two invalid-standards sentinels
tooling.checkpointing: atomic result.json per lane and synthesis call; partial checkpoint reuse requires the frozen initial host digest
tooling.route_preflight: future benchmark preparation records the family route projection for every exact timed and validation prompt

generalized: compress shared invariants rather than evidence boundaries
one synthesis owner preserves all findings
router names dependencies and explicit skips
benchmark the exact natural prompts only after product routing accepts them
execution preserves router and host opt-outs
separate failure sentinels from timed trials
did_not_generalize: a common coordinator for unrelated skill families

reuse_decision.next_gate: A second family must demonstrate the same execution invariants and reduce total maintained code before launcher or coordination utilities are shared.
reuse_decision.bloat_signal: The family launcher is 551 lines and the evaluation harness is 931 lines; neither is a template for blanket replication.
